+            remove = skeleton & (n >= 2) & (n <= 6) & (transitions == 1)
+            if phase == 0:
+                remove &= ~(nbs[0] & nbs[2] & nbs[4])
+                remove &= ~(nbs[2] & nbs[4] & nbs[6])
